question: Who is the author of the Lithuanian novel, ‘The Last Day’, which was translated into Hindi by the Sahitya Akademi in October 2025 as part of celebrating literary exchange and cultural collaboration?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaroslavas Melnikas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jaroslavas Melnikas** is the celebrated author of the **Lithuanian** novel titled **‘The Last Day’** (originally published as **‘Paskutinė diena’**).
 
• The **Hindi translation** of this novel was released by the **Sahitya Akademi** in **October 2025** as a landmark step in fostering **literary exchange** and **cultural collaboration** between **India** and **Lithuania**.
 
• The novel is a profound **philosophical work** that explores a world where every human being knows the **exact date of their death**, challenging the reader to reflect on the value of life and time.
 
• This translation is part of a broader initiative by the **Ministry of Culture** and **Sahitya Akademi** to bring **contemporary European literature** to Indian readers in their native languages.
 
• By translating works from the **Baltic region** into **Hindi**, the project aims to deepen the **bilateral cultural ties** and provide a platform for modern **Lithuanian voices** in the **Indian subcontinent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jaroslavas Melnikas:**
 
 
• Born in **1959**, he is a prominent **Lithuanian-Ukrainian** writer, critic, and philosopher.
 
• His works are known for their **existentialist themes** and have been translated into numerous languages, including **French**, **English**, and **German**.
 
• He has received several prestigious literary awards, and his novel **‘The Last Day’** was a finalist for the **Book of the Year** in **Lithuania**.
 
 
 
• **Sahitya Akademi:**
 
 
• Established on **12 March 1954**, it is India’s **National Academy of Letters**.
 
• The **Sahitya Akademi** promotes literature in **24 Indian languages** and frequently engages in **international translation projects** to promote global literary harmony.
 
• It is headquartered at **Rabindra Bhavan** in **New Delhi**.
 
 
 
• **India-Lithuania Cultural Relations:**
 
 
• The cultural connection between the two nations is historically significant due to the **linguistic similarities** between **Lithuanian** and **Sanskrit**.
 
• Translating modern fiction like **‘The Last Day’** helps modernize this ancient connection by showcasing **21st-century** thought and creativity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Distinguished Lithuanian Authors (Options Analysis):**
 
 
• **Vincas Mykolaitis-Putinas:** A legendary **20th-century** poet and novelist, most famous for his psychological novel **‘In the Shadow of Altars’** (1933).
 
• **Jurga Ivanauskaitė:** A modern writer and **activist** (1961–2007) known for her work **‘The Witch and the Rain’** and her deep interest in **Tibetan Buddhism**.
 
• **Balys Sruoga:** A famous playwright and poet known for the memoir **‘The Forest of the Gods’**, which details his survival in a **Stutthof concentration camp**.
 
 
 
• **Translation Significance:**
 
 
• Translating into **Hindi**, one of the **most spoken languages** in the world, ensures that **Jaroslavas Melnikas’s** unique vision reaches a massive audience, enriching the **Indian literary landscape**.
